title: Fugly But  Sweet Caramel Blondie 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Caramel Blondie from Fugly but Sweet is a guilt-free way to enjoy a truly naughty dessert. A sweet, smooth Vanilla White Chocolate Fudge Brownie filled with a rich, sticky golden Caramel filling for a truly tempting vape that your sweet tooth will do somersaults for. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle ensures your favourite e-liquid really goes the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks. For deliciously decadent dessert flavours, look no further than Fugly but Sweet e-liquids and this collection of four mouth-watering pudding-inspired flavours. Available in long-lasting 100ml shortfills, Fugly but Sweet offers tastes both familiar and unique, with tons of character and an absolutely irresistible moreishness that makes them ideal for any vaper with a raging sweet tooth. If you love Caramel Blondie from Fugly but Sweet, why not treat yourself to other jaw-dropping flavours in the collection? Indulge in the rich, pastry sweetness of Blue Raspberry Cream Pie, or the fresh, fruity creaminess of Dark Fruit Eat N Mess, or the sugary glazed vanilla doughnut bliss of Yum Yum. They may be Fugly, but these flavours are certainly Sweet and absolutely delicious! Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their high VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-liquid helps ensure you don’t run out too quickly.
